name: The Ledger
premise: Money and tech, one mechanism per short. The Ledger explains how a thing actually works (compound interest, index funds, credit scores, GPUs) in 30 to 40 seconds of cinematic AI visuals over a plain, sourced voiceover. No hype, no tickers, no 'buy this'.
audience: 18 to 30 year olds earning their first real money who want to understand it, and anyone curious how the tech behind it works
promise: One thing about money or tech you'll actually understand, every day
anchor: A dark wooden desk at night under a single brass lamp: an open cloth-bound ledger, a mechanical calculator, a cold coffee, and a small glowing screen; the camera always starts or ends here
material: Tommy's own build-in-public work: an AI life-OS app with a portfolio tracker, Wealthsimple sync and a Claude-powered agent; his first investing moves; habit tracking
tone: plain, calm, a smart friend explaining at the kitchen table; a little dry humour
